name: Honduras
summary: Blue, white and blue horizontal bands with five blue stars in an X pattern in the centre. The stars stand for the five states of the former Federal Republic of Central America and the hope of reuniting them.
origin: Honduras was one of five states in the Federal Republic of Central America (1823–1841), which used blue and white. A decree of 16 February 1866 added five stars to the Honduran flag.
In 2022 the government changed the blue to a turquoise shade, citing the original 1866 decree; in 2026 the earlier navy blue was reinstated.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea; also the sky and brotherhood.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: The land between the seas, and peace.

symbols.name: Five stars
symbols.description: Five five-pointed blue stars in an X pattern.
symbols.meaning: The five members of the Central American federation (Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica) and the hope of reunification.

history.label: Five stars added
history.note: Shade of blue changed in 2022 and reverted in 2026.

facts: Honduras's flag has changed shade several times; the stars have stayed the same since 1866.
El Salvador and Nicaragua also use the blue-white-blue Central American pattern.
The five stars echo the five volcanoes on the arms of El Salvador and Nicaragua.
clues: Blue, white and blue bands with five blue stars arranged like an X.
Its stars represent the five states of a former federation.
Its shade of blue changed in 2022.
